bio: Temperance Pringle (c.1802 - after 1860), daughter of Samuel and Martha, married Clark Smith Davenport (1803-1875) on 16 Oct 1825; they lived 11 years in Ohio and had 9 children; in Plymouth in the 1850 and 1860 censuses.
sources: Giles & Franklin, Thomas Davenport, Philipstown Pioneer 1682-1759, and his Descendants (1962): https://archive.org/details/thomasdavenportp00gile (also HathiTrust wu.89066038563: https://babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/pt?id=wu.89066038563&view=1up&seq=395) p.329
